# Input

Use a paired RNA+ATAC Seurat object with broad cell-type metadata, RNA PCA and ATAC LSI. Human workflows use `normal_human_plasma` by default when no medium is supplied; mouse workflows use `mouse_plasma`.

```r
medium_scenarios <- rc_make_medium_scenarios(
  gem = gem,
  scenario = "normal_human_plasma",
  species = "human"
)
```

# One-shot run

```r
result <- rc_run_regcompass_one_shot(
  object = A,
  outdir = "RegCompass_result",
  genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
  species = "human",
  condition_col = "condition",
  celltype_col = "cell_type",
  pando_args = list(
    min_cells = 500L,
    pando_infer_args = list(
      tf_cor = 0.1,
      peak_cor = 0.05,
      adjust_method = "BH",
      padj_threshold = 0.05,
      rank_action = "mark",
      min_residual_df = 1L
    )
  ),
  metacell_args = list(
    gamma = 30L,
    min_cells_per_stratum = 500L
  ),
  layer2_args = list(
    target_direction = "both",
    solver = "highs",
    model_params = list(
      completion_time_limit = 3000,
      strict = TRUE
    )
  )
)
```

`pando_args$min_cells` and `metacell_args$min_cells_per_stratum` both default to `500L`; either value may be explicitly changed by the user.

With `model_mode = "meta_module_gem"`, CORDA2 is the default structural reconstruction. FASTCORE requires `model_params$model_completion = "fastcore"`; `model_mode = "full_gem"` is the supplementary complete-network route.

# Stepwise Layer 2

```r
step5 <- rc_regcompass_step_layer2(
  layer1 = step4,
  meta_modules = step3,
  gem = gem,
  medium_scenarios = medium_scenarios,
  outdir = "RegCompass_steps/05_layer2",
  model_mode = "meta_module_gem",
  layer2_args = list(
    target_direction = "both",
    solver = "highs",
    model_params = list(
      completion_time_limit = 3000,
      strict = TRUE,
      corda2_args = list(
        MCxNCthresh = 2,
        constraint = 1,
        constrainby = "val",
        om = 1e4,
        ci = 0.01
      ),
      corda_medium_confidence_threshold = 0.75,
      corda_negative_confidence_threshold = 0.10,
      corda_regulatory_weight = 0.20
    )
  )
)
```

CORDA2 receives the complete medium-constrained parent without FASTCC pre-pruning. Retained directions recover their parent bounds, including positive lower bounds. Layer 2 uses the COMPASS reaction-cost scale; missing expression and structural roles receive cost `1`.

# Outputs

```r
step5$params
step5$completion_contract
step5$model_cache_summary
step5$vmax_cache_diagnostics
step5$lp_diagnostics
```

The full restartable workflow is in `docs/tutorial-02-stepwise-audit.md`; medium presets are in `docs/medium-presets.md`.
